name: cloudflare-tunnel
description: Cloudflare Tunnel connector: cloudflared 2026.10.7 (the public cloudflare/cloudflared image by digest), run as a remotely-managed tunnel. Its TUNNEL_TOKEN is the owner's, set with service_secret_set; it is created stopped, and instance_start starts it once the token is set. It has no port of its own and reaches only the services it is linked to (service_connect). The public hostnames are set in the Cloudflare dashboard, pointing at a linked service's address and port.
